# Vendored Deslop icons

These SVG files are unmodified selections from `primitives/icons` in
[`mishanaer/deslop`](https://github.com/mishanaer/deslop) at commit
`13b33b82c814d41f83ef224a49f012c81ca5f6c4`.

Exception — `heart.svg` is taken from `61625572c9eb9456cb9c86f30f68bb9b78225648`,
where the icon already paints with `currentColor`. The calendar draws it twice
(stroked = не отмечено, filled = отмечено), and one currentcolor path serves both.
